decisions.reason: The left-text-box wrapping behavior is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Automatic wrapping in Indstilling left-side text boxes does not change the independently defined fixed-margin behavior beneath the Vejledning short-description section.
Text wrapping and column containment do not change how placeholder text must be cleared when an interactive field is activated.
Automatic word wrapping does not alter the required spacing behavior when users intentionally insert hard returns in continuous text.
Automatic wrapping of overflowing text does not change the independent requirement that applicable fields support ordinary Enter-based multiline input.
The source overflow decision does not modify bullet dimensions, alignment, scaling, variants, or approved appearance.
Indstilling text-box wrapping does not change the Board Meeting alignment relationship among Item and Title, Topic, Proposal, and Start time.
The overflow decision does not affect the Board Meeting border behavior triggered by adding a line after a Topic.
Automatic text wrapping does not change the date selector's input method or document contexts.
The Indstilling overflow rule does not alter the requested walkthrough or explanation of Master template tables.
The source decision does not change which theme colors must be included or available to users.
Text-box overflow containment has no effect on first-page footer visibility or the page on which numbering begins.
